content: «Isra7eele asaas, ‹Maccassi shaarada attuma naa yelikko kase maccassa wogay izi bolla beettida wode hanizayssaththo laappun gallas gakkanaas iza tuna gidawus.
Yelettida naazi osppunththa gallas qaxxarettanaas bessees.

Hessafe guye gacino suuththay izippe eqqana gakkanaassinne iza yeloosofe 33 gallas gakkanaas Xoossas dummatida ay miishshika bochchanaas bessenna; hessika iza geeyza wodey wurontta dishin Gaytoteththa Dunkaane giddo geluppu.

« ‹Hessaththoka issi maccassi macca naa yelikko kase bolla qitay izi bolla beettida wode hanizayssatho 14 gallas gakkanaas tuna gidawus; hessafe guye suuththay izippe simmiin iza yeloosofe 66 gallas gakkanaas gam7u.

« ‹Iza geeyza gallassati wuriza wode attuma naa gishshas gidiin woykko macca naa gishshas xuugettiza yarshos issi layththa laaqqanne nagarappe geeyanaas shiiqiza yarshos haraphphe woykko haraphphe ciye Gaytoteththa Dunkaane penge ehada heen ooththiza qeeses immu.
Qeesezikka iza immizayssa izippe ekkidi GODAAS yarsho shiishsho; maccassayakka iza yelishin izippe gukkida suuththaafe geeyawus; hayssi attuma naa woykko macca naa yeliza maccassas wodhdhida woga.

Yelida maccassaya dorsa laaqqa ehanaas dandayonttaaro gidikko nam7u haraphpheta woykko nam7u waanoseta ehu; nam7atappe issoy xuugettiza yarshos, hankkoyssi nagara geeshos yarsho shiiqo; qeesezikka izo nagarappe geeshsho; hessafe guye iza geesh gidana› gees.»
